credits_text: A five part play written by A.S.Pushkin the celebrated Russian author, featuring ... MOZUKIN ... one of the world's greatest actors.
other_text: We are again indebted to "WID" for an intelligent and appreciative criticism of these RUSSIAN ART FILMS: "Feeling that you will surely have success with "The Queen of Spades" I think you can very safely play it up. This is decidedly different from American films in many ways. It is also decidedly more interesting than the average American program offering. Star fine". "Wid's" Magazine offering. Released Nov. 18th
description: A vintage movie poster for "The Queen of Spades" features text highlighting the play's author, Pushkin, and star actor Mozukhin, with an illustration of a queen of spades card.
